name: The King
source:
Though he can be serious and threatening at times, he often is not, and tends to be less formal in mannerisms and behavior. He can be playful and joking at times, evidently not taking his victims or their attempts at resistance seriously, but he is by no means friendly or casual. His actions and speech are both noticeably bold and dramatic, and he is clearly confident in his ability to intimidate others, even just with his presence alone.

He is not actually a king, though none of his victims have any idea who he truly is.

[From [url=https://www.castingcall.club/projects/last-one-standing-royal-massacre-voice-acting-casting-call]Casting Call Club[/url]]
